abaeed47-79ca-4048-b758-2ebe3c9da5c3.hook_pattern: Historical enumeration list + contrarian reframe + punchy closing kicker
abaeed47-79ca-4048-b758-2ebe3c9da5c3.hook_template: Every crypto cycle had its 'this kills it.' [Year] — [fear]. [Year] — [fear]. [Year] — [fear]. Now: [current fear]. [Memorable one-liner prediction.]
abaeed47-79ca-4048-b758-2ebe3c9da5c3.structural_lesson: Stack 3-5 historical fears in rapid list format to trigger pattern recognition. Each item proves the recurring structure. The final item is the present. Close with a confident, almost flippant prediction — the brevity signals certainty. No hedge, no explanation. The list does the persuasion.

dcbc86c9-d939-4f1f-a5fa-42894d4bd513.hook_pattern: Insider resignation + credentialed doomsday warning + reluctance signal + career sacrifice as authenticity marker
dcbc86c9-d939-4f1f-a5fa-42894d4bd513.hook_template: I spent [X years] at [major AI lab]. I'm leaving. I need to tell you what I saw. [First scary claim.]
dcbc86c9-d939-4f1f-a5fa-42894d4bd513.psychological_trigger: Epistemic fear + institutional betrayal + insider credibility + sacrifice-as-sincerity signal
dcbc86c9-d939-4f1f-a5fa-42894d4bd513.structural_lesson: The whistleblower template: open with years spent and institution name, signal the resignation (sacrifice = proof of sincerity), lead immediately into the claim. The more specific the claim, the higher the reach. 90M+ views in 24h and 170M+ in 10 days show the ceiling on this format in AI discourse.

fd582c84-4cae-4fb8-a9b1-0a0a646569d1.hook_pattern: Hidden-danger-in-trusted-product reveal + visual proof + supply chain fear
fd582c84-4cae-4fb8-a9b1-0a0a646569d1.hook_template: I found something inside my [trusted device] that should not be there. [Short description.] [Photo/video of the evidence.]
fd582c84-4cae-4fb8-a9b1-0a0a646569d1.psychological_trigger: Security fear + institutional betrayal + physical evidence (irrefutable) + everyone-is-vulnerable implication
fd582c84-4cae-4fb8-a9b1-0a0a646569d1.structural_lesson: The physical proof post: short text, image carries the message. Include 'inside' or equivalent. Visual evidence short-circuits skepticism. Discovery narrative beats announcement narrative. Ledger/CryptoBilis supply chain hack generated massive secondary commentary — photos/videos of hardware implants seeded hundreds of quote tweets.

14786cfb-5619-4849-a3de-284d148c037f.hook_pattern: Adversity stack + age paradox + institution rejection + eventual proof
14786cfb-5619-4849-a3de-284d148c037f.hook_template: Rejected by [N] [institutions]. Built [X] anyway. [Exit outcome]. Now building [Y]. Here's what I learned institutions can't teach you:
14786cfb-5619-4849-a3de-284d148c037f.psychological_trigger: Underdog sympathy + gatekeeping outrage + aspirational FOMO + identity validation for non-traditional paths
14786cfb-5619-4849-a3de-284d148c037f.structural_lesson: Rejection count must be absurdly specific (15, not 'many'). Arc must be fast: rejection → build → win → next thing. Never dwell on rejection — one sentence max. The asymmetry (rejected by 15, raised $10M by 19) is the content. 'Lessons learned' thread structure invites resharing because it packages aspiration as education.

5c49ac7a-5a01-4aa9-9aa6-c6fac12cd8e6.hook_pattern: Side-by-side visual comparison + shared cultural grievance + participatory mockery
5c49ac7a-5a01-4aa9-9aa6-c6fac12cd8e6.hook_template: Companies are replacing [real thing] with AI-generated [thing]. Here's what that looks like. [Side-by-side image].
5c49ac7a-5a01-4aa9-9aa6-c6fac12cd8e6.psychological_trigger: Shared outrage + humor + collective identity protection + universal relevance
5c49ac7a-5a01-4aa9-9aa6-c6fac12cd8e6.structural_lesson: Comparison image that crystallizes a broader frustration generates outsized engagement because it gives people a shareable artifact to pile onto. AI food photos hit 13M+ views because food is universal, images were visually wrong in ways everyone could see, and it invited participation. The participatory element is the multiplier.

4f8b3bcf-0d42-42c2-8999-6aea5403edcc.hook_pattern: Meta-contrarian: reframe the prevailing viral narrative as a commercial or strategic move
4f8b3bcf-0d42-42c2-8999-6aea5403edcc.hook_template: Everyone is sharing [person]'s [scary warning]. What they're not saying: [alternative explanation that reframes it as self-interest/marketing/strategy].
4f8b3bcf-0d42-42c2-8999-6aea5403edcc.psychological_trigger: Intellectual superiority (I see what others miss) + cynicism-validation + anti-groupthink identity
4f8b3bcf-0d42-42c2-8999-6aea5403edcc.structural_lesson: Second-order contrarian: when a post goes massively viral, there's always a high-engagement wave questioning the motives. Requires no original research — just a reframe. Works best as a single short tweet. Must name the viral post by implication, not quote. Cynicism resonates with sophisticated-insider identity.

de9ffeeb-3c76-4c5d-8bf9-f17bb83c6421.hook_template: I built [X]. Today, [X] is [ending/joining/changing]. Here is what that means for everyone who used it — and what comes next.
de9ffeeb-3c76-4c5d-8bf9-f17bb83c6421.psychological_trigger: Community identity threat + nostalgia + pragmatic concern + curiosity (what happens to my project?)
de9ffeeb-3c76-4c5d-8bf9-f17bb83c6421.structural_lesson: Creator's voice (not corporate), acknowledge community investment first, explain the decision second, give a concrete migration timeline third. The thread replies are the real content — the original tweet is a catalyst. Developer communities reshare these at extremely high rates.
